text:
Alex: heads-up — CI microbench flagged a regression on PR #13100, kv_warmup_latency +18% on aarch64 workers :grimacing:
ci-bot: [alert] microbench/kv_warmup increased beyond threshold for pr/13100. artifact: https://ci.redwood/pr/13100/artifacts/kv_warmup/summary.txt
Maria: ugh. PR touched batch timer and the kernel_affinity map right?
Alex: yeah small change in runtime scheduler, moved default batch_timer_ms from 3 -> 6 in opt path, and added pragmatic kernel affinity rule for small seqlen workloads
Sam: can you paste the bench diff?
Alex: here's the benchdiff output, copied from artifact:
```
metric                base        pr         delta
kv_warmup_latency     12.4ms     14.6ms     +17.7%
batch_tail_p50        4.1ms      4.3ms      +4.9%
kv_cache_hit_rate     88.2%      87.5%      -0.7%
```
June: 18% on warmup is a lot. does this reproduce locally on an aarch64 runner?
Alex: I repro on a local a72 docker image with similar CPU profile, yes. Not on x86 CI images.
Maria: that hints at kernel selection interplay with the HW-specific kernel. maybe the affinity rule picked a slower kernel on aarch64 for certain seqlen distribution.
Sam: can we run kernel selector trace? run: `bazel run //bench:kv_warmup -- --trace-kernel-selection=out.json` and attach out.json to the PR job.
Alex: kicked an ad-hoc job with that flag, uploading trace now.
ci-bot: upload complete: https://ci.redwood/pr/13100/artifacts/kv_warmup/trace.out.json
June: quick grep of trace shows many calls choosing `kern_v1_small_batch` on pr, base chose `kern_v0_prefetch`.
Maria: kern_v1_small_batch has different prefetch strategy that can increase initial kv load latency on aarch64 due to memory ordering.
Sam: ok can we bisect commit boundary in the PR? try reverting the change to kernel_affinity only, keep batch_timer_ms tweak.
Alex: did that quick revert in a temp branch and ran microbench: kv_warmup_latency back to 12.6ms (within noise). so kernel_affinity tweak is the main culprit.
June: nice repro. what's the best short-term mitigation to unblock rollout? revert the kernel affinity part in the PR and keep batch timer change for follow-up?
Maria: agree. revert kernel-affinity. add test coverage to prevent selector choosing kern_v1_small_batch on aarch64 for kv warmup profile.
Sam: also add an expedited CI job: run microbench on both x86 and aarch64 for any kernel-affinity changes. small cost but worth it.
Alex: will open follow-up PR to revert kernel-affinity and add selector unit test + aarch64 microbench step.
Alex: pushing revert now...
ops-bot: deploy gate: PR 13100 now marked WIP due to perf regression.
ci-bot: new run for 13100-revert uploaded: https://ci.redwood/pr/13100-revert/artifacts/kv_warmup/summary.txt
Alex: re-run summary shows kv_warmup 12.5ms, back to baseline. leaving notes in PR and will follow up with safer selector tuning. :thumbsup:
Maria: thanks. file an RFC for kernel affinity heuristics; we keep hitting arch-specific surprises.
June: adding to backlog and scheduling a short sync with infra to define a presubmit microbench gating strategy.
Sam: thanks everyone. small follow-up: let's add an assert in selector that logs when chosen kernel differs between archs for same seqlen distribution. should help catch this earlier.
Alex: noted. closing the alert.
